_about: Per-user mainframe settings. Copy this file to 'mainframe.config.json' in the same folder and fill in your own values. 'mainframe.config.json' is listed in .gitignore, so it stays on your machine and is never committed. boot.ps1 reads bitwardenEmail when the Bitwarden CLI needs a login; the MAINFRAME_BW_EMAIL environment variable overrides it. ntfyTopic configures phone approval push notifications for vault unlock during restores; the MAINFRAME_NTFY_TOPIC environment variable overrides it. ntfyToken is the ntfy access token (tk_...) that owns the topic - set it when the topic is PROTECTED, so ntfy refuses an anonymous read of the approval requests; the MAINFRAME_NTFY_TOKEN environment variable overrides it. ntfy tokens are NOT topic-scoped: a token grants full access to its ntfy account, so it belongs in this local file only. ntfyServer is the approval relay base url; leave it empty for https://ntfy.sh, or point it at a reachable ntfy-compatible relay when the machine's egress proxy denies ntfy.sh (the MAINFRAME_NTFY_SERVER environment variable overrides it). pagesBase is the base url that serves docs/vault-tab.html; leave it empty for the GitHub Pages url of the public tool repo, or point it at a first-party host so the tap link is not a raw github.io path (the MAINFRAME_PAGES_BASE environment variable overrides it). vaultTtlMinutes defines the local vault session key TTL in minutes (default 60); expired sessions auto-lock and re-prompt for 1-tap mobile approval.
